name: Build + Test v2

on:
  push:
    branches: [release/*, master, bugfix/*]
    paths:
      - 'v2/**'
      - '.github/workflows/build-and-test.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test_go:
    name: Run Go Tests
    if: github.repository == 'wailsapp/wails'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      GOWORK: "off"
      # Fail on a Go version mismatch instead of silently downloading a toolchain.
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
    strategy:
      matrix:
        # Every platform tests the newest Go release; ubuntu-24.04 also tests
        # the oldest supported one.
        os: [ubuntu-22.04, ubuntu-24.04, windows-latest, macos-latest]
        go-version: ['1.27']
        include:
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, go-version: '1.26' }

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install apt packages (ubuntu-22.04)
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-22.04'
        run: |
          # Drop the runner image's unused Microsoft apt repos (no-op off GitHub-hosted runners).
          ./.github/scripts/prune-runner-apt-sources.sh
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libgtk-3-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.0-dev build-essential pkg-config

      - name: Install apt packages (ubuntu-24.04)
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-24.04'
        run: |
          # Drop the runner image's unused Microsoft apt repos (no-op off GitHub-hosted runners).
          ./.github/scripts/prune-runner-apt-sources.sh
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libgtk-3-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev build-essential pkg-config libegl1

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v4
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
          cache-dependency-path: ./v2/go.sum

      - name: Run tests (mac)
        if: matrix.os == 'macos-latest'
        env:
          CGO_LDFLAGS: -framework UniformTypeIdentifiers -mmacosx-version-min=10.13
        working-directory: ./v2
        run: go test -v ./...

      - name: Run tests (!mac)
        if: matrix.os != 'macos-latest' && matrix.os != 'ubuntu-24.04'
        working-directory: ./v2
        run: go test -v ./...

      - name: Run tests (Ubuntu 24.04)
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-24.04'
        working-directory: ./v2
        run: go test -v -tags webkit2_41 ./...

  test_js:
    name: Run JS Tests
    if: github.repository == 'wailsapp/wails'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [20.x]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
        working-directory: v2/internal/frontend/runtime

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test
        working-directory: v2/internal/frontend/runtime

  test_templates:
    name: Test Templates
    needs: test_go
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      GOWORK: "off"
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
    strategy:

        template:

            svelte,
            svelte-ts,
            vue,

            react,

            lit,

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
